lines.text: Many learners say: I and my friend went to the park.
Better: My friend and I went to the park.
My sister and I! My sister and I went to the park.

data.wrong: I and my friend went to the park.
data.right: My friend and I went to the park.
data.memory: My friend and I went to the park.

native.hook: 「I and my friend」と言ってない？
native.tip: 自分は後ろに置きます。My friend and I … が自然です。
native.caption: “I and my friend went to the park.”と言っていませんか？😅 日本語の「私と友達は」の順にすると、英語では不自然になります。“My friend and I went to the park.” が自然な言い方です。Amaの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“My sister and I”。“My friend and I went to the park.” を声に出して言ってみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.hook: Do you say “I and my friend”?
en.tip: Put yourself last: my friend and I.
en.caption: Do you say this? “I and my friend went to the park.” 😅 The Japanese order 私と友達 sounds odd in English, so put I last. The natural way is “My friend and I went to the park.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
